pieces.Text: Cryptic powers show up on your body in the form of tattoos. Your known powers can be identified via Spellcraft checks with a DC equal to 10 + double the power's level. These tattoos do not count against the number of psionic tattoos that you can safely wear. When you manifest one of your powers, it creates a visual pattern of energy during the action taken to manifest the pattern. While your powers have the normal displays for psionic powers - auditory, mental, and the like - this visual pattern unique to the cryptic cannot be suppressed as normal displays can be suppressed.
